author: Bubblegums8
quote: Waited 13 years for “Can’t Theft Auto.” If you’re hoping for an escape from work, your relationship, or just everyday life and want to have some freedom and liberty to do what ever you want, then don’t waste your money. Fortunately for me, I have a PC and have to watch other people’s game play throughs to make my opinion and from what I saw, they took away a lot of features that made people GTA fans in the first place. If you were a loyal fan and wasted $80 on this feminist propaganda, you have my sympathy.
